hints.title: Tally Increments by Row and Column
hints.text: Record the total number of operations affecting each row and each column independently.

hints.title: Calculate Parity Counts
hints.text: Count how many rows have an odd number of increments (odd_r) and how many columns have an odd count (odd_c).

hints.title: Combine Odd Intersections
hints.text: The total odd cells equals odd_r * (n - odd_c) + (m - odd_r) * odd_c, since odd plus even is odd.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def oddCells(self, m: int, n: int, indices: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows = [0] * m
        cols = [0] * n
        for r, c in indices:
            rows[r] ^= 1
            cols[c] ^= 1
        odd_r = sum(rows)
        odd_c = sum(cols)
        return odd_r * (n - odd_c) + (m - odd_r) * odd_c
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating full matrix increments takes O(L * (M + N)) or O(M * N) space and time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting row and column parity takes O(M + N) space and solves the cell count in O(L + M + N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid constructing the 2D matrix and evaluate odd cells via row/column parity.
complexity.notes: Odd plus even equals odd; odd plus odd equals even.
